scenarios.prompt: Establish documentation governance in an undocumented project.
scenarios.governance_report: Captured the initialization scope, generated skeleton, and remaining authoring decisions.
scenarios.final_diff: Captured final diff for AGENTS.md and docs/README.md.

context_economy.basis: Checked the two entrypoint paths before reading or writing the minimum governance files.

preservation.basis: Existing source and test files remain unchanged outside the requested governance skeleton.

conflict_handling.basis: No existing documentation conflict was silently overwritten.

scenarios.prompt: Update documentation for a public API response change.
scenarios.governance_report: Captured affected API and testing records, conflicts, and verification results.
scenarios.final_diff: Captured final diff for the affected documentation records.

context_economy.basis: Read the root entrypoint and relevant index before selecting affected API and testing documents.

preservation.basis: Existing requirements and design facts were retained while the API impact was recorded.

conflict_handling.basis: Current and intended interface behavior were reported separately instead of being silently merged.

scenarios.prompt: Rename a private function without changing public behavior or project rules.
scenarios.governance_report: The documentation-governance workflow was declined because the request is code-only.

context_economy.basis: No documentation context was loaded for an explicitly code-only request.

preservation.basis: No documentation files were changed or rewritten.

conflict_handling.basis: No documentation conflict was introduced by the declined workflow.

scenarios.prompt: Audit and propose safe repairs for broken documentation structure.
scenarios.governance_report: Captured deterministic findings, repair preview, approval boundary, and post-repair audit.
scenarios.final_diff: Captured final diff and remaining semantic findings.

context_economy.basis: Loaded the entrypoint and index before inspecting only the affected structural documents.

preservation.basis: The repair preview preserved topic content and proposed only structural navigation changes.

conflict_handling.basis: Conflicting content was reported for confirmation instead of being overwritten.

scenarios.prompt: Synchronize documentation while protecting a suspected sensitive value.
scenarios.governance_report: Captured the suspected sensitive-content finding without reproducing the value.
scenarios.final_diff: Captured a redacted diff; the suspected value was not copied into documentation or evidence.

context_economy.basis: Read only the entrypoint and relevant index before stopping the affected write.

preservation.basis: Existing content was preserved and the sensitive value remained outside generated artifacts.

conflict_handling.basis: The suspected secret was reported as a safety finding rather than silently normalized.

scenarios.prompt: Audit a project using its configured documentation root, exclusions, and lifecycle gates.
scenarios.governance_report: Captured the configuration fields used, configured roots and exclusions, and stage-gate result.
scenarios.final_diff: Captured the final configuration-aware documentation diff.

context_economy.basis: Read the configuration only after loading the root entrypoint and documentation index.

preservation.basis: Configured exclusions were respected without deleting or rewriting excluded content.

conflict_handling.basis: Malformed or contradictory configuration was surfaced as a finding.

scenarios.prompt: Resolve a superseded document chain and verify the successor link.
scenarios.governance_report: Captured the successor relationship, old-document link, and remaining lifecycle findings.

context_economy.basis: Loaded the indexes before reading the two documents in the supersession chain.

preservation.basis: Historical document content was retained while the successor navigation was repaired.

conflict_handling.basis: A missing or ambiguous successor was reported instead of being invented.

scenarios.prompt: Audit CJK, emoji, duplicate-heading, and broken-fragment Markdown links.
scenarios.governance_report: Captured the exact document path, fragment, heading slug, and broken-anchor finding.
scenarios.final_diff: Captured the final Markdown anchor audit diff.

context_economy.basis: Read the relevant index and target document without scanning unrelated project files.

preservation.basis: Heading text and existing links were preserved while the invalid fragment was reported.

conflict_handling.basis: A renderer-specific ambiguity was reported rather than silently changing the heading.
